description: Register of gaps preventing REPEATABLE_SYSTEM claim

gaps.title: Zero-byte restore logs for 16 NO_LOWCODE families
gaps.detail: All 16 restore logs in reports/lowcode-systemization-26family-20260530/discovery/restore-logs/ are 0 bytes. These families: barcode, cad, drawing, finance, font, gis, html, imaging, note, omr, page, svg, tasks, tex, threed, zip.

gaps.title: Missing restore logs for 9 additional families
gaps.detail: No restore logs exist for: cells, words, pdf, diagram, slides, email (6 LOWCODE), ocr, psd, pub (3 NO_LOWCODE added in 26-family). epub is EXTERNAL_PACKAGE_BLOCKER (expected to fail).

gaps.title: Missing reflection raw for 9 families
gaps.detail: No reflection-raw JSON for: cells, words, pdf, diagram, slides, email, epub, ocr, psd. Only 17 of 26 families have reflection-raw.

gaps.title: 7 missing PDF assembly manifests
gaps.detail: Only pdf-controlled-pilot-pr10.json exists. Missing: pdf-controlled-pilot.json, pdf-controlled-pilot-pr5.json through pr9.json, pr11.json. Canonical packager cannot cover all 47 examples.

gaps.title: Duplicate examples inflate canonical count
gaps.detail: email-converter is a duplicate of email-converter (in email-controlled-pilot). slides-compress/slides-convert/slides-merger duplicate compress/convert/merger. True canonical count is 43, not 47.

gaps.title: Idempotency only proven for Words family
gaps.detail: Prior sprint proved Words package idempotency (64/64 SHA-identical). Other 5 LOWCODE families (cells, pdf, diagram, email, slides) not yet proven.

gaps.title: Forbidden comments not scanned
gaps.detail: 'no suitable overload found' and similar forbidden comments may exist in publication candidates. No scan performed in prior sprint.

gaps.title: ZIP artifact metadata SHA/size mismatch
gaps.detail: Prior sprint ZIP build script computed SHA of tmp ZIP (before metadata added), wrote to metadata, then built final ZIP (with metadata). Final ZIP has different SHA/size. Recorded: 892577.../247 entries. Actual: b0aaca17.../251 entries.

gaps.title: Generation provenance not audited
gaps.detail: 47 examples in workspace/pr-dry-run have unknown provenance — unclear which were generated by canonical_packager vs copied from prior sprint workspace runs.
